findings.invariant_violated: real-mirror reflection must depict the same pose at the same instant
findings.description: Within the same frame, the dancer's left arm hangs at her side and her right arm is raised diagonally (~45 degrees, upper-right), but her reflection shows one arm extended horizontally at shoulder height and the raised arm positioned on the viewer-LEFT side of the figure with a flopped hand. A plane mirror preserves screen-side position, so the reflection depicts a different and laterally swapped pose at the same moment.

findings.invariant_violated: real-mirror reflection must depict the same pose at the same instant
findings.description: The dancer's left arm hangs down at her side, yet the reflection shows the corresponding arm bent at the elbow with the hand held out at shoulder height; the reflection's raised arm is again on the viewer-left side of the figure while the dancer's actual raised right arm is on the viewer-right side. No visible action accounts for the extra active arm in the reflection.

The dancer raises her right arm straight up (arm on the viewer-right side of her body, left arm down), but in the reflection the raised vertical arm appears on the viewer-LEFT side of the figure with the hand flopped leftward. The one-arm-up/one-arm-down configuration otherwise matches, indicating a left-right swap impossible for a plane mirror.
